subject: Fastlane pilot — request to offer conversion subsidy
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fastlane pilot — request to offer conversion subsidy

Hi team,

Quick ask: Fastlane Analytics (Jordan Price / Maria Gomez) are in our pilot and the PO is stuck in procurement — they’re price sensitive and indicated that a one-time credit tied to first-month usage will get legal/procurement across the line. They’re a high-fit case for our Dedicated offering and likely to convert to a 12-month commit.

What I’m proposing: a one-time conversion subsidy of $15k in platform credits (apply to first invoice) + a 30-day trial extension to give them headroom for integration testing. Total expected cost = ~ $15k in NRE credits; revenue upside $120k ARR if they commit.

Why now: they asked for a final incentive before EOW to meet their internal Q3 close. I haven’t promised anything externally — waiting on internal signoff.

Requested approvals:
- Marketing/Revenue floor OK on $15k credits? (Marissa)
- Legal OK on promo language and billing attachment? (Aditya — I’ve attached draft MOP_Terms_v2.pdf)
- Operations: confirm we can apply credits to first invoice and extend trial programmatically (Monica)

Attachments: credit_approval_sheet.xlsx (cost calc), MOP_Terms_v2.pdf (draft wording)

If we get a yes by EOD today I can send the formal offer and get DocuSign started.

Thanks,
Dylan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-06T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fastlane pilot — request to offer conversion subsidy

Dylan — thanks for the concise ask. I’m okay to authorize a one-time $15k credit under the conditions below:

Conditions (please follow exactly):
1) Credit is one-time, non-recurring, applied to first invoice only. No automatic renewals.
2) Customer must sign the attached promo_credit_agreement.pdf (legal to review language).
3) We require a signed Letter of Intent or PO with target start date within 45 days.
4) Keep net new ARR forecast conservative — credit counts against SDR/AE incentive plan if we don’t get >50% of projected ARR within 90 days.

Marissa — please confirm budget/marketing approval on the promo. Aditya — please review and redline the attached MOP_Terms_v2.pdf and promo_credit_agreement draft. Monica — confirm whether we can automate the 30-day trial extension and apply credit via billing.

If all green, Dylan send the offer to Jordan and CC procurement / legal.

-Lauren
VP Sales Operations

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@fastlane.ai>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@fastlane.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Bcc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-06T13:37:00-07:00
Subject: Fastlane pilot — formal credit offer and trial extension

Jordan / Maria — great talking earlier. Per our conversation and internal approval, we can offer the following to help unblock procurement: 

Offer details:
- One-time promotional credit: $15,000 applied to first invoice (non-recurring).
- 30-day trial extension starting on activation date.
- Promo contingent on: signed promo_credit_agreement (attached) and a PO / LOI within 45 days.

Attached: promo_credit_agreement.pdf — please review. Once you approve we’ll issue a DocuSign and apply the credit on your first invoice. Monica (cc) will handle the billing application and trial extension.

Next steps:
1) Jordan/Maria confirm acceptance of the terms.
2) We’ll send DocuSign within 24 hours.
3) Procurements executes PO and onboarding kickoff scheduled.

Happy to hop on a quick call if procurement needs more detail.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: promo_credit_agreement.pdf

---
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@fastlane.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@fastlane.ai>, procurement@fastlane.ai
Date: 2027-09-07T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fastlane pilot — formal credit offer and trial extension

Dylan — appreciate the quick response and the proposal. Fastlane accepts the promotional credit and trial extension as outlined. A couple of small asks before we sign: 

1) Can the credit be listed on the invoice as a line item with the credit code so our finance team can match it to PO?
2) We prefer Net 45 payment terms on the first invoice (we can flex to Net 30 after the pilot).

If you can include those two items in the DocuSign we’ll route it through procurement today and aim to return the signed PO by EOD.

Jordan Price
Head of Analytics, Fastlane Analytics

- Add 'Promotional Credit - DL-2027-0451' as a discrete line item on the first invoice with the credit code.
- Apply 30-day trial extension from activation date via feature-flag; engineering ops will schedule the change.
- Net 45 on the first invoice is acceptable for this case; update DocuSign with Net 45 term.

I’ve also added the credit_approval_sheet.xlsx to the deal and notified Finance to watch for the PO. Please send DocuSign with the two items Jordan requested and loop procurement.

Monica Patel
